summary: Join our expert-led training course on sentencing and restitution in financial offences. Equip yourself with the knowledge to navigate complex legal frameworks.
lede: Sentencing and restitution in financial offences connect evidence of harm with proportionate outcomes and recovery. For investigators, prosecutors, compliance teams, auditors, and legal or finance professionals, the course addresses how to support sentencing and restitution decisions with a clear case record. Participants examine sentencing factors, assemble evidence linking an offender to financial harm, quantify losses, and develop realistic restitution plans with monitoring steps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals involved in financial crime cases who need to ensure that outcomes are lawful, fair, and defensible.
audience: Legal officers in corporates, government agencies
Risk managers and fraud prevention teams
modules: Understanding Financial Offences and Why Outcomes Matter
Principles of Sentencing in Financial Offences
Restitution, Compensation, Forfeiture, Fines, and Penalties
Negotiations, Plea Options, and Settlement Considerations
Communicating and Defending Sentencing and Restitution Recommendations
Restitution Monitoring, Compliance, and Post-Judgement Follow-Up
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial crime investigation and legal processes. Experience in compliance, auditing, or legal advisory roles is beneficial but not mandatory.
